$comment: SAML IdP registration template — EMPLOYER ADFS (sts.hssmartdev.com).
This registers the employer's proprietary ADFS as an INBOUND federation
source on cwl-idp. cwl-idp is the SP; ADFS is the external IdP. Feed this
body to the ZITADEL Management API: POST /management/v1/idps/saml
(org-scoped) with an Authorization: Bearer <mgmt PAT from KV> header.
The employer ADFS is a COMPATIBILITY TARGET, never the hub.
Placeholders {{like_this}} are resolved by tooling from the KV config
store at apply time — do not hardcode metadata URLs or secrets here.

$comment: ADFS emits WS-* / SAML claim URIs. Map UPN and email so that:
- the SAML nameID (EmailAddress format) is the stable subject, and
- verified email drives AUTO-LINK-BY-VERIFIED-EMAIL on first login.
In ZITADEL these map onto the SAML provider's attribute options; the
it will auto-link — never link on an unverified assertion.
isCreationAllowed  -> JIT provisioning on first federated login.
isLinkingAllowed   -> allow tying this ADFS identity to an existing user.
